Garage description
Exclusive paint awarded to players who have achieved great victories in eSports. This paint is given to winners of the «Major Rankings I» tournament.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint was first issued to the winners of the 2nd season of the Masters of the sword tournament:
May 26, 2017 - to winners of the Tandem and Trio categories;
May 30, 2017 - to the winner of the Solo category;
May 31, 2017 - to the winner of the Clans category (Major League).
Players who receive this paint will also receive a unique Spectrum B module with  20% protection against all turrets and mines.
The paint was given to the winners of {GAME}Sport Season 1 - Revenge.
The paint was given to the winners of Major Rankings I - Diamonds & team defeats.
